full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE 2010 SP MEMBER EDSEL A.P. CASILLANO City of Borongan, Eastern Samar Dear SP Member Casillano This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion as to who, between the OIC Vice-Mayor and the President Pro-Tempore, should preside over the proceedings of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of the City of Borongan in view of the Vice-Mayor's official travel outside his territorial jurisdiction. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 4, series ofeooa. In the said legal opinion, we opined that being an Acting Vice-Governor does not automatically vest upon the said official the power to preside over the Sangguniang Panlalawigan citing the case of Gamboa vs. Aguirre and Araneta (G.R. No. 134213, 20 Ju/y 1999). Under Section 49 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160), in the event of the inability of the regular presiding officer to Preside at a sanggunian session, the members present and constituting a quorum shall elect from among themselves a temporary presiding officer. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: A Ls/17 . JESUS DOQUE Director III
